title: Agent Guidelines for imuRUN
text: Package Purpose: Routine-Use Notebooks (imuRUN) provides user-facing CLI spreadsheet-friendly workflow runner imuGAP. accepts single-file .xlsx workbooks (loose CSV/RDS input directories) containing observations, locations, optional sampler configuration, evaluation targets, validates inputs friendly schema, delegates model fitting imuGAP::sampling(), generates posterior coverage predictions arbitrary age spans/locations, produces amended Excel workbooks (styled results tab) clean CSV summaries. .xlsx reading, sheet inspection, workbook modification/amendment, style preservation (freezing, autofilters, dropdowns), writing handled exclusively via openxlsx2. readxl writexl intentionally dependencies. R functions primary interface: run_fit(), validate_inputs(), imurun_init(), read_inputs(), write_results_workbook(). CLI wrapper installed onto PATH via imuRUN::install_cli() (creates symlink Unix imurun.cmd shim Windows pointing inst/scripts/imurun.R). Every input must define evaluation targets (target sheet target.csv), specifying requested locations, years, age spans (age_low age_high). amending existing workbook -place model results, imuRUN preserves non-data tabs (e.g. instructions), column filters, formatting. man/*.Rd docs/ generated roxygen2 / pkgdown untracked git. NAMESPACE tracked git.

title: Agent Guidelines for imuRUN
text: Format code just format (air). Verify lint compliance just lint (air lintr). Maximum line length 100 characters. validate_inputs() check_all_inputs(), collect report missing sheets, columns, invalid values rather failing first error. Typography: Use backticks (`code`) function/argument/symbol names single quotes ('value') user string values, column names, sheet names, file paths. roxygen2 markdown mode enabled (Roxygen: list(markdown = TRUE)). Use markdown links formatting roxygen tags. Maintain high test coverage (>90%) across R modules. Fixtures (example.xlsx, example_corrupt.xlsx, example_dir) generated data-raw/make_workbooks.R (just data).

Youngest age Oldest age: age span surveyed (put age single age, just use Youngest age). Dose: dose count represents (e.g., 1 2). Vaccinated: Number individuals found vaccinated. Sampled: Total number individuals sampled (Vaccinated must <= Sampled). Censored (optional): Leave blank, enter 1 right-censored. Location: unique name location. Target Year: calendar year prediction snapshot. Youngest age Oldest age: age range want coverage estimated . Dose (optional): Leave blank predict final dose, specify dose number. Label (optional): descriptive tag echoed results (e.g., Schools 2025). configuration: Settings model fit. default values (2000 iterations, 4 chains) work well analyses, can safely leave sheet -.

Scriptable. engine functions (run_fit(), read_inputs(), validate_inputs(), read_workbook(), friends) exported use directly R. optional CLI wrapper returns shell exit codes (0 success, 1 validation, 2 model, 3 /O) use pipelines.

title: Canonical imuGAP input schema — IMURUN_SCHEMA

Columns: obs_id (unique identifier – loader assigns one automatically omit , user column), loc_id (must exist locations), year (positive integer observation year), age_min age_max (positive integers giving inclusive age span count drawn , age_min <= age_max), dose (integer 1:max_dose), positive (non-negative integer count positive results), sample_n (positive integer sample size, positive <= sample_n). Optional: censored (NA 1). single-age observation may written one age column instead age_min/age_max; loader expands age_min = age_max = age (see expand_obs_age()). locations: location hierarchy. Required columns: loc_id (unique identifier), parent_id (parent's loc_id, NA single root).

title: Expand a compact target-request sheet into explicit target rows — expand_targets

title: imuRUN 0.1.0
text: Initial release. Exported core CLI engine ordinary R functions: run_fit(), read_inputs(), load_by_ext(), find_input_file(), check_all_inputs(). Added install_cli() put bundled imurun command PATH. Added .xlsx workbook input mode: read_inputs() now accepts either directory CSV/RDS files single workbook one sheet per input, via new read_workbook(). Missing sheets reported . Pinned canonical input schema IMURUN_SCHEMA shipped blank template workbook (inst/templates/imurun_template.xlsx) plus small filled example (inst/extdata/imurun_example.xlsx) derived imuGAP’s *_sim data; resolve imurun_template() / imurun_example().
